algorithm: One global stable (ts, ts+dur) order and numeric event-order positions; sort each existing group by integer positions, preserve original-order count/sum and exact per-group union recurrence. Avoid per-event mutable membership/state lists and eager default-list allocations. Keep all duplicate memberships.
gain: Target measured allocation/GC cost of 5,331,778 membership insertions without changing audit fields or GC policy. Full speed improvement is not yet measured.
alternative_not_selected: Compact numeric membership offsets require two construction passes and more source for the same allocation target; not implemented.
remaining_seven_precondition: Fresh complete P0rank0 final JSON, exact identity/fields/index and >=3 useful steps; primary acceptance required.
primary_scope: New command receipts/control and affected allocations, exact complete-output checks, independent Spec/Standards reviews, final acceptance and commits.
controls_required: Every non-clock JSON field, count/sum/union/hierarchy/leaf/per-stream and decompressed kernel index exactly equal to the retained completed outputs; preserve float hex and duplicate memberships.
forbidden: Raw inputs, original outputs, sealed runtime/package or native/C26 changes
Timeout/memory increase, skipped events, changed attribution or raw-ID mapping
Spent drivers/tiny/full controls rerun or import
